title: Global forward self-similar solutions of the spatially inhomogeneous Boltzmann equation for cutoff Maxwell molecules
summary: For every fixed $m>1$, we construct nonzero global forward self-similar mild solutions of the three-dimensional spatially inhomogeneous Boltzmann equation for Maxwell molecules. We assume that the angular kernel is bounded and satisfies a weighted integrability condition at the grazing and head-on angles. The initial data are homogeneous under the kinetic scaling, singular at the origin in phase space, and have infinite mass. Their size is small in a weighted norm invariant under this scaling.
